excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Doubao released multiple updates for productivity scenarios, including an upgraded "work task mode" interface. A new sidebar workbench has been added to the right side of the "Chat" page, consolidating task-related resources in a multi-tab format, allowing AI conversations and hands-on operations to take place on the same screen without frequent window switching. The sidebar workbench supports opening local files, Feishu Docs, online web pages, as well as code, apps, and terminals, covering the main scenarios of daily office work and application development. For long tasks, multiple outputs generated in the conversation—such as apps, files, and images—are displayed side by side in tabs for one-click viewing. Each conversation has its own independent workbench, and switching tasks automatically restores the previous state, preventing scattered outputs and difficult backtracking in long conversations. In application development scenarios, the sidebar workbench supports real-time code preview. After generating a webpage, users can click the "Edit" button to fine-tune specific details without regenerating the entire page. For office documents, Feishu Docs, PPT, and Excel can all be opened directly in the sidebar workbench, and model-generated content updates to the document instantly, eliminating the need for copy-paste and re-saving. In addition, the model can directly browse and operate web pages within the sidebar workbench, independently performing searches, clicks, page turns, and information extraction based on user instructions, and organizing summaries based on web content. items.title: 携手韶音，光帆的「AI OS 野心」已经藏不住了
items.raw_excerpt: 2026 年 8 月 18 日，韶音在上海举办媒体沟通会，正式发布开放式耳机新品 OpenFit 2 AI。而光帆科技作为韶音重要的技术合作伙伴，为本款产品提供了 AI 技术支撑。 沟通会上，韶音宣布与光帆科技达成 AI 技术合作，将在 OpenFit 2 AI 中上线基于光帆自研 AI OS 的效率功能合集 ——“AI 实验室”，为智能对话、日程待办、快记快查、智能消息等创新类 AI 能力提供技术支撑，助力韶音为强沟通人群打造更高效的 AI 耳机体验。值得关注的是， 这是光帆 AI 技术能力首次正式落地第三方头部硬件品牌，标志着其系统化 AI 能力已从自有产品验证，进阶为可向行业伙伴输出。 基于光帆自研 AI OS 的效率功能合集——“AI 实验室”，即将在韶音 OpenFit 2 AI 耳机上线。 目前 AI 硬件正加速进入端侧规模化落地阶段。据 The Business Research Company 预测，2026 年全球 AI 耳机市场规模将达到 74.2 亿美元，2030 年有望增长至 173.4 亿美元。 在中国市场，开放式耳机是增长最快的细分品类之一，IDC 数据显示，2025 年中国开放式耳机出货量达 2996 万台，同比增长 20.2%。作为该品类的全球头部品牌，韶音此次与光帆的合作，也代表着开放式耳机率先从单点 AI 功能走向系统化 AI 能力。 与此同时，AI 硬件的竞争焦点正在迁移：接入大模型不再是稀缺能力，真正拉开体验差距的是 AI 体系化能力。多名业内人士对雷峰网·鲸犀表示，过去几年 AI 在耳机上的落地多为降噪、佩戴监测等单点功能，而真正的分水岭在于 AI 能否提供更主动智能、更多样化的能力，并依托系统化支撑实现跨应用调度。此次光帆与韶音的合作，正是这一行业趋势的代表性落地。 据雷峰网·鲸犀了解，光帆此次在 OpenFit 2 AI 耳机上

excerpt_i18n.en: In recent years, as domestic competition intensifies and new models such as fully managed services emerge, a growing number of domestic trade merchants have begun expanding overseas in search of new business opportunities. At the same time, many brands that grew up in overseas markets are now ramping up efforts to develop their domestic operations—examples include consumer electronics brands like Anker and OnePlus. Under this two-way flow, the integrated development of domestic and foreign trade is becoming the new normal for a growing number of enterprises. According to data from the Ministry of Commerce, as many as 87,000 industrial enterprises above designated size have achieved integrated domestic and foreign trade operations. Walking on two legs—domestic and foreign trade—brings double the opportunities, but it also drives operational complexity up exponentially. Domestic e-commerce, cross-border e-commerce, B2B, and B2C each follow completely different operational logics; the demographics and consumer preferences across different platforms and channels also differ significantly. These dimensions intersect, making operations suddenly far more difficult. Relying purely on manpower is no longer enough to cope with such a complex landscape. Business can be conducted across multiple platforms, but can management and operations exist on one and only one platform? Driven by this strong demand, Accio, which already has 10 million users in the cross-border e-commerce space, has broken through barriers to connect with major domestic platforms including Taobao, Tmall, Pinduoduo, JD.com, and Douyin Store. Multiple e-commerce platforms, one AI workstation—this is exactly what has emerged. The e-commerce AI Agent has also begun integrating domestic and foreign trade. Accio was originally an AI Agent launched by Alibaba International on the Alibaba.com platform, designed specifically to help B2B foreign trade business owners run their businesses.
excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos años, con la intensificación de la competencia interna y el impulso de nuevos modelos como la gestión integral, cada vez más comerciantes del mercado interior empiezan a salir al extranjero en busca de nuevas oportunidades de negocio. Al mismo tiempo, muchas marcas que han crecido en los mercados internacionales también están empezando a operar en el mercado nacional, como las marcas de productos electrónicos de consumo Anker y OnePlus, entre otras. Con este flujo bidireccional, la integración del comercio interior y exterior se está convirtiendo en la nueva normalidad para un número creciente de empresas. Según datos del Ministerio de Comercio, solo entre las empresas industriales por encima del tamaño designado, 87.000 han logrado operar de forma integrada en el comercio interior y exterior. Caminar sobre las dos piernas del comercio interior y exterior ofrece el doble de oportunidades, pero también multiplica exponencialmente la complejidad de la gestión.
